name.description: Display name of the LLM provider, e.g. Anthropic.

apiKeySource.description: Where AICo reads the provider's API key, never the key itself. Absent for servers without authentication, such as a local Ollama.

kind.description: env: read the API key from an environment variable.

variable.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key, without $, e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
variable.patternErrorMessage: must be an environment variable's name, without $: letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit

oneOf.description: Read the API key from an environment variable.

kind.description: file: read the API key from a file.

path.description: Path of the file holding the API key: absolute, starting with ~, or relative to the project's root.

oneOf.description: Read the API key from a file.

connections.description: How the provider is reached: one connection per API protocol it speaks, all sharing its API key.

baseUrl.description: URL the protocol's paths are appended to, e.g. https://api.anthropic.com, or http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama's OpenAI-compatible API.

auth.description: How the API key is sent: an x-api-key header (the default), or an Authorization: Bearer header, as OpenRouter expects.

openai-chat-completions.description: Connection through OpenAI's Chat Completions API, which sends the API key as a bearer token.

baseUrl.description: URL the protocol's paths are appended to, e.g. https://api.anthropic.com, or http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama's OpenAI-compatible API.

openai-responses.description: Connection through OpenAI's Responses API, which sends the API key as a bearer token.

baseUrl.description: URL the protocol's paths are appended to, e.g. https://api.anthropic.com, or http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama's OpenAI-compatible API.

title: AICo LLM provider
description: Configuration of an LLM provider, in .aico/llm-providers/<provider-id>/config.json. Its models live next to it, in models/<model-id>/config.json.
